COPY the entire contents of the original HTML file.
ADD a new navigation pill in the header for 'Intelligence' and set it to active. Remove 'active' class from 'Dashboard'.

BUILD the Intelligence dashboard inside this new div based on the components_to_build structure above.
ENSURE you strictly use Tailwind CDN classes and Lucide icons as already present in the HTML document.
